<cite ref="Berakhot 13b:21">Ber. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>בפסוקא ק׳</he> at the recitation of the first verse of the Sh’mʿa; a. fr.—<he>תנא ק׳</he> (abbrev. <he>ת״ק</he>) the first of the quoted authorities.
<cite ref="Berakhot 48b:4">Ib. 48ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>בבא ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00050"><he>בָּב</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>קַמָּאֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:4">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>לא הוה להון למילף מן ק׳</he> ought they not to have taken a lesson from (the fate of) their predecessors? <cite ref="Berakhot 20a:5">Ber. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ … מסרי וכ׳</he> the former generations gave up their lives &c.
B. Bath. 46ᵇ ק׳ דקמך those who have long preceded thee; a. fr.—Fem קַמַּיְיתָא.
